items.title: Billie Pierce and De De Pierce Interview, 1959-04-02
items.q: The interviewer asks 'That was Mr. Scholle?' and the interviewee confirms 'Oh yeah', but no personal interaction, collaboration, or mentorship is described between the interviewee and Mr. Scholle.

ctx.x: Oh yes, I did. I used Otto Langley.
Oh yeah, strictly music, strictly music. In other words, he played several instruments, you see. More teaching than anything else.
